description: This file is a C header file declaring exported API functions for a DSL Home Model component related to TCP connection request handling. It contains function prototypes for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the object, along with licensing and module information.

methods.name: DslhCreateTcpConnReqHandler
methods.description: Creates and returns a TCP Connection Request Handler object with specified container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: DslhTcpcrhoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the TCP connection request handler with specified contexts.

methods.name: DslhTcpcrhoRemove
methods.description: Removes and cleans up the specified TCP connection request handler object.

methods.name: DslhTcpcrhoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls necessary objects into the TCP connection request handler instance.
